posts.subject: Servers are temporarily down
posts.bodyHtml:
Hello non-German players,



our situation is pretty tough recently.


The servers were shut down temporarily because of several DDoS-attacks.


The team tried, and is still trying, to stop the attacks. They also tried to set up a better protection against it, but it didn't work that well.
The fact we know is that a guy rent a botnet to harm us but we do not know who he is... YET! We will find that out hopefully. Hopefully really soon.


The admin team apologizes and really tries their best to stop that idiot who is attacking the servers.



Have a nice day

Our situation?
Since when are you an owner?
I speak in the name of the whole community.

Habe deinen Beitrag ein wenig editiert, sodass es nicht klingt, als wären die Server permanent down, sondern nur vorübergehend. Ebenso, da du nicht zum Team gehörst, habe ich den entsprechenden Satz auch ein klein wenig geändert.


Dennoch danke für deine Hilfe.
